description: Put a live chart on the user's telo iPhone home. Only when the user asks to pin, save, show or keep something on telo. The card keeps updating with each sync. Styles: trend (line), stat (number and change), bars. Optional: compare_with draws a second metric on the same window; baseline=personal draws the user's usual range; display=pace_km turns running_speed into min/km; goal only when the user stated one; color only when the user asks (cards default to a color per metric category); size=half puts two consecutive half cards side by side (a number and a small trend, details on tap); change_from=usual or year_ago changes what the change line compares with. Always pass the user's question in their words; it is shown on the card.

baseline.description: Draw the person's usual range: mean ± 1 SD of the 60 days before the last week

change_from.description: What the card's change line compares today's value with. window_start (default): the first point of the window; usual: the user's own 60-day average ending a week ago; year_ago: the 14 days around the same date last year

color.description: Only when the user asks for a color. Omit to use telo's default for the metric's category

compare_with.description: A second metric drawn on the same window, each on its own scale

display.description: Only for running_speed or walking_speed: show min:sec per km instead of m/s

value.description: Target in the card's displayed unit. For display=pace_km, seconds per km (5:00/km = 300).

metric.description: Exact metric name from list_metrics, e.g. vo2_max, running_speed, hrv_sdnn

question.description: The user's question or request that led to this card, in their words

size.description: half: two consecutive half cards share a row, as a number and a small trend line. Default full

style.description: trend: line chart; stat: number and change; bars: per-day or per-week bars

name: pin_card
title: Pin a chart to the telo home
